decision: Selected the centroid of Maricopa County Assessor parcel 304-03-011X (situs 3261 S Hawes Rd, Mesa; owner of record LOOP 202 & ELLIOT ROAD LLC), the single current parcel that contains both City of Mesa permit geocodes of the EdgeConneX campus (PHX11 at 3261 S Hawes Rd and the PHX12 civil-and-shell / EDCPHX12 permits at 3319 S Hawes Rd), as the campus locator.

selected_properties.spatial_reference: outSR=4326 (WGS84) as returned by the assessor's ArcGIS MapServer

computed.method: Single-ring polygon returned by the assessor service in WGS84; centroid computed in EPSG:32612 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 12N) and returned to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: City of Mesa Building Permits (dzpk-hxfb): the permits at 3261 S HAWES RD (parcel 30403011V in the permit records) are titled 'Mesa EdgeConnex SRP Substation', 'EdgeConnex Onsite' (civil improvements 'supporting single building data center facility'), 'EdgeConnex Hawes Road Improvements' ('to support the construction of private data center project'), 'EDGECONNEX PHX11' (core and shell, 412,065 sq ft), 'Data Hall 1-2 Buildout', 'Data Hall 3-4 Buildout', 'TEMP CONSTRUCTION TRAILER - EDGECONNEX PHX11', 'EdgeConnex PHX-II' and 'Edgeconnex Tent Permit'.

The PHX12 records cite parcel 30403011X: 'Civil and Shell' (PMT25-22027, a new 296,800 sq ft precast core-and-shell building, no street address), 'At Risk Grading Permit' (PMT26-00745, referencing PMT25-22027) and 'EDCPHX12 - Tenant Buildout' (PMT26-08118 at 3319 S Hawes Rd: tenant improvement of a 296,800 SF shell building whose foundations and chiller dunnage are under PMT25-22027A). PMT25-22027 and PMT26-08118 share the city geocode (-111.649893, 33.355042).

The current assessor layer has no parcel 304-03-011V (an APN query for 30403011% returns only 304-03-011X); point-in-polygon queries at the PHX11 geocode (-111.652901, 33.354696) and at the PHX12 geocode both return 304-03-011X, whose situs address is 3261 S HAWES RD, MESA 85212, the PHX11 permit address. The owner of record is LOOP 202 & ELLIOT ROAD LLC with a Herndon, Virginia mailing address (deed 20240455346, 27 August 2024, the same day the EdgeConneX onsite civil and Hawes Road permits were issued).

EdgeConneX's Phoenix location page (dateModified 23 March 2026) brands its facilities 'Edge Data Center (EDC)' and says EdgeConneX has 'land in Mesa, Arizona available to be developed for a build-to-suit data center solution'.
unresolved: The owner of record's name does not name EdgeConneX; the operator link rests on the EdgeConneX-titled city permits on the parcel and the EDCPHX12 title, not on ownership.
The positions of the PHX11 and PHX12 buildings within the 93-acre parcel are only indicated by the city geocodes; the centroid locates the campus property, not either building footprint.
The assessor publishes no positional accuracy for parcel polygons.
nearby_records: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping coordinate, pending fragment, claim or hold coordinate lies within 2 km of the centroid. The nearest Atlas sites are Google Mesa Red Hawk (2.54 km) and the imported EdgeCore Mesa point (3.01 km). Meta's Mesa campus at 3841 S Ellsworth Rd (city permit geocode) is about 1.71 km south-east; the imported Meta Mesa record itself uses a Mesa city-centre locality point about 18 km away.

consistency_checks.datum: WGS84 output from the assessor's ArcGIS service (outSR=4326)
